overview_description.description: AI Proctor is a tech company that develops proctoring software for online exam assessments. The company's platform provides real-time monitoring and browser monitoring, and it works even during internet outages and power outages thanks to artificial intelligence, allowing clients to monitor students during assessments. It consists of a web application used by the examiner to configure proctoring options and add the exam link or upload exam questions, a desktop application for the test taker that acts as a secure browser, and an optional mobile app companion to proctor the student using the mobile camera in addition to the laptop camera.

product.name: AI Proctoring System
product.description: A software system that monitors online exams using AI to detect suspicious activities and ensure exam integrity.

product.name: Real-Time Monitoring Dashboard
product.description: A dashboard that allows instructors to observe exam takers live, receive alerts on suspicious activities, and interact with students during exams.

product.name: Browser and Program Activity Monitoring
product.description: Monitors students' browser tabs and running programs during exams to detect unauthorized access or usage.

product.name: Face Verification and Identity Authentication
product.description: Verifies student identity before and during exams using facial recognition to ensure the registered student is taking the test.

product.name: Human Speech Detection
product.description: Monitors the exam environment's audio to detect human speech and prevent unauthorized communication during exams.

product.name: Offline Event Caching and Recovery
product.description: Caches suspicious activity data locally during internet or power outages and uploads it once the connection is restored to ensure no cheating events are lost.
